rows.quote: GWAS summary statistics for AKI in the discovery cohort were obtained from the FinnGen database (version R12, https://r12.finngen.fi/, GWAS ID: finngen_R12_N14_ACUTERENFAIL), comprising 8,383 cases (3,194 females and 5,450 males) and 480,448 controls, with a total of 20,112,606 SNPs.
rows.coder_note: Sentence states the discovery GWAS is from the FinnGen database version R12 and gives a finngen_R12 GWAS ID.
Sentence gives an accession inside the range the dictionary lists for one row of the cited source, with a sample size above that row maximum; the cited entry DOI is shared by three rows.
UKB-PPP named with a citation shared by several rows and a participant count that equals no UKB-PPP row size.
